model_source: Already downloaded local snapshot; exact weight hashes recorded at runtime.
selection: All records with split=train, no development or test labels; deterministic Trainer shuffle.

memory_implementation_revision.reason: Initial attempt ran out of MPS memory at optimizer step 37 before any checkpoint; no model evaluation had started.
memory_implementation_revision.invariant: Same answer-token set likelihood, seed, model and all learning hyperparameters; validate numerical equivalence before rerun. Do not disable the MPS memory limit.

objective: Negative log total sequence probability of all acceptable next decisions; final assistant tokens only.
overflow_policy: Fail before training; do not truncate away answers or silently remove records.
primary_evaluation: Held-out closed-loop success with independent state/invariant checks; compare unfine-tuned same model and non-neural baselines.
interpretation: One 135M model and one training seed establish an engineering experiment only. Training loss alone cannot establish Agent capability or the research hypothesis.
